nodes.name: Inserted?
nodes.notes: 004-triage, T5: a duplicate delivery (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING skipped the insert, inserted=false) never triggers Triage Pipeline -- only a genuinely new row does (FR1/AC4). Purely additive: this node and 'Call Triage Pipeline' are the only change this task makes to this already-live workflow.

nodes.name: Upsert contacts

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO contacts (account_id, name, email, domain, is_vip)
SELECT
  $1,
  p->>'name',
  p->>'address',
  split_part(p->>'address', '@', 2),
  false
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS p
WHERE NOT ($3 AND p->>'role' = 'from')
ON CONFLICT (account_id, email) DO UPDATE SET name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, contacts.name);

nodes.notes: 011-followups-contacts-api, T5: runs after 'Inserted?'s true output (a genuinely new email only), before 'Insert thread_entries' and the fan-out to Triage Pipeline / Action Extraction. Upserts a contacts row per participant, keyed on (account_id, email); is_vip is never touched by the ON CONFLICT update so a dashboard-set VIP flag is never reverted by a later inbound email. $3 (is_from_user) excludes the 'from' participant when this email is one the account owner sent, since that participant IS the owner -- every other participant (to/cc, and every participant on an inbound email) is upserted.

nodes.name: Insert thread_entries

nodes.notes: 011-followups-contacts-api, T5: runs sequentially after 'Upsert contacts', before the fan-out to Triage Pipeline / Action Extraction. Records this email as a thread_entries row (author, timestamp, a gist truncated to 200 chars) for the followups feature. email_id is read via the explicit $('Format output') cross-node reference rather than $json, because this node's immediate predecessor ('Upsert contacts') is an INSERT with no RETURNING clause and its output does not carry email_id.

nodes.name: Call Triage Pipeline
nodes.notes: 004-triage FR2/NFR2: fires Triage Pipeline non-blocking (waitForSubWorkflow: false) so Gemini's latency/availability can never affect this already-verified ingestion path (002-ingestion AC1-AC5). References the 'Triage Pipeline' sub-workflow BY NAME (cachedResultName), same placeholder pattern this file's own callers already use -- workflowId.value is left blank until triage-pipeline.json is imported and this node is re-pointed at it via n8n's resource picker. 011-followups-contacts-api, T5: email_id now reads via the explicit $('Format output') reference instead of $json, since this node's immediate predecessor is now 'Insert thread_entries' (a Postgres node whose output no longer carries email_id) rather than 'Format output' directly.
